summary: First E2E test of Gandhikar. Backend: 9/9 pytest passing (health, auth register/login/me, wrong-password 401, 23 languages, 3 models, 8 topics, SSE chat stream + session/messages persistence + delete, TTS audio). Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844): Login screen renders with correct testIDs; wrong password shows 'Invalid credentials' error; correct login navigates to chat tab. Chat: 4 suggestions render, mic-button visible, tapping a suggestion streams a Claude Sonnet 4.5 answer that includes exact citations (Article 22(1), Section 35 BNSS). Rights tab lists 8 topics; expanding shows law citation + points. History tab lists past sessions; tapping opens session detail. Settings tab shows profile, pick-language modal has 23 options (including 'hi'), pick-model modal has 3 options, helplines (112/181/15100/1098/14433) visible. Signup screen accessible (go-to-signup) and testIDs present. Logout button present but not confirmed E2E — see notes.

integration_issues.issue: If user navigates away before the SSE stream finishes (e.g., quickly taps another tab), only the user message is persisted; the assistant message is not saved because it is written only after the async generator completes. Session detail then shows just the question with no answer. Consider persisting assistant partial content on client disconnect or streaming through a background task.

Logout uses React Native Alert.alert; on web this may not trigger a standard window.confirm dialog, so automated dialog handler could not confirm. Could not verify end-to-end logout in Playwright. Manually verify or replace with a Modal-based confirmation to make it testable and consistent on web.

issues: Send button is hidden while streaming (only mic visible). This is intentional but users may want a Stop control; consider showing a stop/cancel button during streaming.

action_items: Consider persisting assistant response even if the SSE client disconnects mid-stream (fire-and-forget task) so that history shows the assistant answer when the user opens the session later.
Replace Alert.alert for logout confirmation with a Modal (or make Alert use window.confirm on web) so logout is deterministically testable on Expo web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: SSE JSON is hand-crafted with string escaping. Works but json.dumps({...}) would be safer and less error-prone.
server.py: /voice/transcribe and /voice/tts should validate content size and language code; TTS voice is not restricted to supported values.

server.py: CORS is wide open with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True — invalid combination per CORS spec; browsers may reject credentialed requests. Set specific origins or drop credentials.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all core flows verified except logout confirm dialog and mid-stream persistence)

seed_data_creation: Auto-created testuser@gandhikar.in on register (idempotent via login fallback). Additional TEST_new_* users created by test_register_new_user_returns_token. 1 chat session was created during frontend chat test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Test user: testuser@gandhikar.in / test1234. Emails are lowercased server-side. SSE payload types: session|delta|done|error. Frontend tabs on web are clickable via page.get_by_text('Rights'/'History'/'Settings', exact=True). Topic list on rights-screen loads after ~1-3s (wait_for_timeout(3000) recommended). Logout uses Alert.alert — not confirmable via browser dialog handler.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bug. Two enhancement items filed under integration_issues.
